passages.text: A biological membrane is a lipid bilayer with embedded proteins.
A primary key uniquely identifies a table row and cannot contain null values.
Binary search requires sorted input and halves the search interval at each step.
A stack follows last in, first out.
A queue follows first in, first out.
Lexical analysis groups source characters into tokens before parsing.
A process is a running program with its own execution state.
Bubble sort compares adjacent elements and swaps out-of-order pairs.
FRAP measures fluorescence recovery after a small region is photobleached.
A foreign key references a key in another table.
